blind.description: A classic ball and chain restraint (shackle). It features a round metal spherical weight with pitted surface indentations, attached via a short chain of links to an openable hinged metal cuff/ankle shackle. The surfaces are continuous, solid, and finished with a weathered, tarnished iron/bronze metallic texture with rusty patches. Rests directly and naturally on the ground without an added plinth or floating pieces.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a spherical cannonball/weight connected by a short curved metallic chain to an open circular ring-shaped ankle cuff.
blind.height_vs_figure: Very low to the ground, with the spherical ball standing roughly 8 to 10 inches tall and the entire chain-and-cuff span extending about 1.5 to 2 feet long, small compared to the 5 ft 9 in figure.
